neighbours.label: the verb of beginning or arrival inside a once- or until-clause: 'Once your child starts', 'until the pain starts', 'until you get to'
fire: Once the baby starts crawling, you should cover the sockets.

Once you begin saving, the habit gets easier.
Rest the knee until the swelling starts to fade.
Once the music starts, nobody will hear you.
Stay on the trail until you get to a wooden bridge.
Once they started talking, the room felt warmer.
